_comment: Tracks for gen_audio_fal.py. 'name' must match a file made by gen_audio_procedural.py: the fal version replaces it at import. kind: music | sfx. No vocals, no voices, no recordings of real events.

tracks.name: music_setar
tracks.prompt: Solo Persian setar, quiet and intimate, slow melancholic melody in Dastgah Shur, unresolved ending, close microphone, small room, no percussion, no vocals, instrumental

tracks.name: music_setar_resolved
tracks.prompt: Solo Persian setar, the same slow melancholic melody in Dastgah Shur, tender, this time resolving gently to the tonic, peaceful ending, close microphone, no percussion, no vocals, instrumental

tracks.name: music_daf
tracks.prompt: Persian daf frame drum in a driving 6/8 rhythm with slowly rising cinematic strings, tense, hopeful, building, protest in the streets at night, no vocals, no chanting, instrumental, loopable

tracks.name: music_chase
tracks.prompt: Fast urgent Persian percussion, daf and tombak, rapid hands, heart-pounding chase, dry, no melody, no vocals, instrumental, loopable

tracks.name: music_sunrise
tracks.prompt: Slow Persian ney flute over warm sustained strings, sunrise over mountains, bright, tender, grief and peace, spacious, no percussion, no vocals, instrumental

tracks.name: amb_wind
tracks.prompt: Soft wind over city rooftops before dawn, distant, empty, no voices, no traffic, seamless loop

tracks.name: amb_city
tracks.prompt: Distant city traffic hum on a warm afternoon, far away cars, no horns, no voices, seamless loop
